assertions.statement: Only uncancelled Xianyu orders with status 21 or 22 expose the Web-admin dispatch backfill action to users with rental:xianyu:ship.
The dialog accepts device number, waybill, carrier code/name, actual ship time, and reason without requiring physical scanning hardware.
The dialog explicitly states that the operation restores local records and never calls the remote XianGuanJia shipment API.
POST /admin-api/rental/xianyu/order/dispatch-backfill is protected by rental:xianyu:ship and validates the complete typed request.
Pending, refunded, cancelled, and closed orders are rejected before device mutation, shipment persistence, delivery creation, or remote calls.
A successful backfill creates or reuses conversion, assignment, occupied schedule, DISPATCHED state, RENTED device state, ADMIN_BACKFILL shipment, and outbound delivery in one transaction.
The backfill path never reads Xianyu write-enabled runtime configuration and never invokes XianyuWriteClient.
The same normalized idempotency request replays the original result without duplicate writes, while conflicting reuse is rejected.
A business-key collision that binds the same order and waybill to another device is rejected as a dispatch backfill conflict.
Cross-tenant order or shop references and non-shippable device states are rejected without partial local writes or remote calls.
Delivery or persistence failure rolls back assignment, schedule, device, shipment, and channel-order changes.
The admin feature passes backend compilation/tests and frontend type, lint, format, and diff checks.
The complete flow works by Web keyboard input for an authorized administrator and refreshes the order list after success.
Desktop and narrow layouts are usable in light and dark themes for zh-CN and en, including validation, loading, conflict, error, and success states.
